name: io.github.taliasoftworks/planvortex
title: PlanVortex
description: Schedule posts, read comments and answer messages across twelve social networks.

environmentVariables.name: PLANVORTEX_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client id of a PlanVortex app (Custom plan). Panel: Settings > Apps.

environmentVariables.name: PLANVORTEX_ORGANIZATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default organization id. Optional: saves a discovery call per conversation.

environmentVariables.name: PLANVORTEX_MCP_UPLOAD_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Directories upload_media may read from. Empty means none.

environmentVariables.name: PLANVORTEX_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to remove the nine write tools.
